_about: F59 unlock lesson: the start of the first shift at rank 3 or more (swap unlocks at progression.json unlocks.swap). An interrupt like unlock-window, pointing at the next-piece window (what a swap trades for); the words follow the input used last (keys / mouse / phone). Once per device; one unlock lesson per shift start (src/game/lessons/unlockLessons.ts). Words: content/text/en.json → lessons.unlock-swap.
